description: This file defines the Clock system for the Kivy framework, including classes for different clock behaviors, methods for scheduling, unscheduling, and managing callbacks, as well as handling asynchronous operation and exceptions. It also provides decorators for main thread execution and triggered callbacks.

classes.name: ClockBaseBehavior
classes.description: Base class for Kivy's clock system, managing timing, scheduling, asynchronous support, and exception handling.

classes.name: ClockBaseInterruptBehavior
classes.description: Subclass of ClockBaseBehavior that supports interruptible clock operations during a frame.

classes.name: ClockBaseInterruptFreeBehavior
classes.description: Subclass of ClockBaseInterruptBehavior that handles free events, interrupting sleep for free scheduled callbacks.

classes.name: ClockBase
classes.description: Default clock implementation, combining ClockBaseBehavior with CyClockBase, providing core scheduling and timing functionalities.

classes.name: ClockBaseInterrupt
classes.description: Interruptible clock implementation, combining ClockBaseInterruptBehavior with CyClockBase.

classes.name: ClockBaseFreeInterruptAll
classes.description: Clock that supports free events with no fps limit, combining ClockBaseInterruptFreeBehavior with CyClockBaseFree.

classes.name: ClockBaseFreeInterruptOnly
classes.description: Clock that treats free and normal events independently, combining ClockBaseInterruptFreeBehavior with CyClockBaseFree.

methods.name: init_async_lib
methods.description: Sets the asynchronous library (asyncio or trio) for the clock.

methods.name: usleep
methods.description: Sleeps for a specified number of microseconds (implemented differently per platform).

methods.name: idle
methods.description: Waits until the next frame, synchronously.

methods.name: async_idle
methods.description: Asynchronous version of idle, waits until the next frame.

methods.name: _check_ready
methods.description: Checks if the clock is ready to proceed based on fps and timing.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Advances the clock by one tick; should be called every frame.

methods.name: get_fps
methods.description: Returns the current average frames per second.

methods.name: get_rfps
methods.description: Returns the real FPS, i.e., the display frame rate.

methods.name: get_boottime
methods.description: Returns the time since application start.
